name: 76701 · Waco, TX
findings: ZIP 76701 (Waco) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76701 (Waco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 76701 (Waco) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
